rows.value: UK Biobank SAIGE PheWeb (Zhou et al. 2018)
rows.quote: Disease GWAS from this database used scalable and accurately implemented generalized linear mixed models (SAIGE V.0.29) to address imbalanced case–control ratios [15] (https://pheweb.org/UKB-SAIGE/).
rows.reference_quote: Zhou W, Nielsen JB, Fritsche LG, et al. Efficiently controlling for case-control imbalance and sample relatedness in large-scale genetic association studies. Nat Genet. 2018;50(9):1335–41.
rows.coder_note: The UK Biobank disease GWAS are attributed to reference 15 (DOI 10.1038/s41588-018-0184-y, the Zhou 2018 row alone) and to pheweb.org/UKB-SAIGE; the 408,961 maximum and 1403 diseases given elsewhere agree.

rows.quote: METHODS: A two-sample MR analysis assessed the impact of specific plasma proteins on CLL risk, using data from the Finngen Proteomics project (analyzing 828 participants) and the UK Biobank.
rows.coder_note: The sentence names the protein data as the Finngen Proteomics project (828 participants); the dictionary has no pQTL row for FinnGen.
